title: plot.linspace~
description: `plot.linspace~` outputs a signal containing a specified number of evenly spaced values over a linear interval, intended for use with `array.plot~` or `ui.plot~`. A bang starts output, while a float sets the number of values via `@n`; the start, stop, and inclusion of the stop value are controlled by `@start`, `@stop`, and `@endpoint`.
